summary: Iteration 2 — Planning tab + customizable status colors. Backend: 33/33 pytest tests pass, including 4 NEW preferences tests (GET returns defaults with 5 keys, PUT partial merges with defaults, PUT full palette persists, and cross-user scoping). Auth guard extended to /api/preferences (GET + PUT return 401 without token). Existing endpoints (auth, properties CRUD, reservations CRUD+PATCH status, dashboard, AI guest-reply, AI pricing) all regression-green. Frontend: seeded a session_token directly into IndexedDB (db 'AsyncStorage', store 'keyvaluepairs') and intercepted /api/auth/me — full authenticated navigation achieved on mobile viewport (390×844). Verified: Planning tab is present in bottom tab bar (Accueil/Réservations/Planning/Logements/Assistant); segmented toggle Réglette/Mois works (testIDs planning-mode-timeline, planning-mode-month); property chips render (prop-chip-all + prop-chip-<id>, French label 'Tous' + 'Villa Test'); month nav works (prev-month/next-month, label 'Août 2026'); Timeline view renders property rows + colored legend and produces timeline-bar-<id> for the seeded reservation (1 bar found); Month view renders 31 day-<YYYY-MM-DD> cells with status dots; gear (open-color-settings) navigates to /settings/status-colors; 50 swatches rendered (5 statuses × 10 colors, testIDs swatch-<status>-<hex>); tapping a new swatch + save-colors persists and routes back to /planning. Console still logs the previously-reported React-Native-Web deprecations (shadow* props and props.pointerEvents) — non-blocking but should be migrated.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — planning.tsx segBtnActive uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (planning.tsx:379). Migrate all shadow* usages across StyleSheet.create() to the unified boxShadow style.
React Native Web logs 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — move any pointerEvents={...} JSX prop into style. Likely in overlay/ui components.

action_items: Migrate deprecated RN-Web styles: replace shadow*/shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius keys with the new boxShadow style (start with planning.tsx:379 segBtnActive), and move any pointerEvents JSX prop into style.pointerEvents.

Optional hardening: /api/preferences PUT accepts any dict for status_colors — consider validating hex format and that keys are within the 5 known statuses (unknown keys currently persist silently after being spread into the merged doc).
Consider making the 401 handler in /app/frontend/src/api.ts less aggressive on the first cold-boot /auth/me call (still noted from iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DEFAULT_STATUS_COLORS + merge-on-PUT keeps behavior forward-compatible (partial payloads work).
Preferences are correctly scoped per-user via upsert on user_id.
planning.tsx uses testIDs consistently for every interactive element (segments, chips, month nav, timeline bars, day cells, day-res items).
status-colors.tsx uses a Record<StatusKey, string> draft state and only commits on save — good UX.
Timeline bar rendering clips correctly at month boundaries (nights <= 0 short-circuits).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (added TestPreferences class + test_preferences_scoped_per_user + 2 new auth-guard params for GET/PUT /api/preferences)
